description: T10-3 pin: save_session's INSERT drops its column list and relies on the table's column count and order, so every write to a database carrying an extra column fails ('table sessions has 9 columns but 7 values were supplied').

target.find:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sessions
                    (id, label, started_ns, ended_ns, source_path, event_count, language)
                VALUES
target.replace:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sessions
                VALUES
